note: Quoted max_tokens keys: in raw HTTP bodies (requests, httpx, fetch, axios) and in SDK calls. Detection counts every quoted or bare max_tokens entry, ten per file; the log strings are not entries. check keeps only those in a chat completions SDK call or in a request whose URL names /v1/chat/completions, and drops another vendor's, legacy completions, the config object, the log call and the payload passed by name (test/check.test.ts). The quoted keys are reported only: the rules rename just the bare-key SDK call, as in basic/.
